subject.title: Image tool fails to resolve media:// protocol paths for inbound Discord media

question: Should maintainers require live Discord DM attachment proof before authorizing a repair lane for this issue?
rationale: Current main already proves generic media URI handling, so the remaining repair choice depends on live evidence that identifies whether Discord loses the media ID, active state root, or file lifetime.

options.title: Run live Discord proof first
options.body: Capture the saved path, emitted `media://inbound` ID, active state dir, and image-tool result on current main before opening a repair lane.

options.title: Wait for reporter logs
options.body: Keep this open until the reporter provides targeted logs or environment data showing the current-main failure mode.

options.title: Fold into broader media retention triage
options.body: Treat this as part of the repeated-read media lifetime cluster if maintainers decide the cross-channel symptom is the same root cause.

recommendation.title: Run live Discord proof first
recommendation.body: Capture the saved path, emitted `media://inbound` ID, active state dir, and image-tool result on current main before opening a repair lane.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current managed inbound-media reference path and are the strongest history owner for deciding the proof boundary.
